name: phoenix-security-review
description: AppSec review suite: multi-language security-reviewer (8-point check, 7 language packs, OWASP/ASVS + endpoint checklists), whole-repo security-assessment, diff-scoped 0day-scanner, STRIDE/DREAD threat-modeling, and two threat-model-driven tiers (tm-quick-security-assessment, tm-security-review). Ships 4 slash commands, a security-reviewer subagent, and 3 opt-in hooks.
